extension.name: Mollie Payment Processor
extension.description: Payment processor for Mollie supporting one-off and recurring donations via the Mollie PHP SDK.
extension.comments: Integrates Mollie (https://www.mollie.com) as a payment processor for CiviCRM. Supports one-off and Mollie-managed recurring payments (subscriptions) using the official Mollie PHP SDK. Includes webhook-driven payment status updates, automatic subscription sync, chargeback and refund handling, pre-payment reminder emails, and an admin dashboard with live Mollie API detail views. Designed for European nonprofits using Mollie for donor payment processing.
